scientific_integrity: General statement follows from finite 8-block synchronization and factor-saturation lemmas plus exact occurrence-decimation induction. Finite enumeration alone is not the general proof.
scientific_limitations: Only standard binary Rudin-Shapiro dyadic prefixes with exponent at least nine. Related unpublished or unindexed exact classifications may exist. Independent verification has not been performed.
title: Shortest unique factors of finite Rudin–Shapiro words
